caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a detailed representation of a rabbit sculpture. The sculpture is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a metallic or stone-like appearance. The rabbit is shown in a sitting position, with its hind legs tucked under its body and its front legs extended forward. The ears of the rabbit are upright and close together. The surface of the rabbit features smooth areas as well as some subtle texture that suggests the material. A visible seam runs down the front of the rabbit from the neck to the bottom, indicating it may be constructed from two joined parts or cast in sections. The drawing is executed on a light, plain background, and the object is centered within the composition. There is a small signature or annotation in the lower left area near the rabbit.
title: Garden Figure (Rabbit)
